names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 12 martie, «Sfântul Cuvios Teofan Mărturisitorul»; the hymn pages for the day print him «Teofan Mărturisitorul din Singriana».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 12 Μαρτίου, «Όσιος Θεοφάνης ο Ομολογητής της Συγριανής», with the rank words left off.

The forename is read out of the Ohrid Prologue's first heading for the Julian 12 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Преподобни Теофан Исповедник.“, with both rank words left off — Преподобни and Исповедник, which are the two the folder's `types` carry. The by-name is read out of the body's first sentence, which gives it and explains it: he was called Sigrian because of the place Sigria where he was born. It is kept rather than stripped, as Тирон and Двојеслов are kept elsewhere in this wave, and it is what this folder's English name already carries.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 12 martie — «Sfântul Cuvios Teofan Mărturisitorul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 12ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιος Θεοφάνης ο Ομολογητής της Συγριανής»

attestations.note: The page heads him «(760 - 815)», names his parents Isaac and Theodotia, has him orphaned of his father at eight, married at his mother's entreaty to the devout and rich Megalo, and the marriage dissolved — she became a nun at the monastery of Prinkipos under the name Irene, and he withdrew in 781 to the monastery of Polichnion by the mountain of Sigriane. Of the place itself it says «Η Συγριανή βρισκόταν είτε στη Μήδεια είτε - το πιθανότερο - στην Μυτιλήνη [ακρωτήρι Σίγρι]», either in Media or, more probably, at Mytilene.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 25.03.2026 (12. март ст. ст.) — „Преподобни Теофан Исповедник.“

attestations.note: The day's first entry. The heading's two words are both rank words, so the bare forename it leaves would fold with `theophanes-the-confessor-9-september`; the body's own first sentence supplies and explains a by-name instead — „Прозват Сигријан због места Сигрије, где беше рођен.“ — and that is the form stored, by the settled rule that a by-name the body explains is kept. The entry gives no year of any kind: it names Leo the Isaurian and his son Copronymus as his kinsmen, the Seventh Council, Leo the Armenian's persecution, two years in prison and twenty-three days on Samothrace, and no date. The folder carried no dates before this reading and carries none after it.

hymns.text: Cu curgerile lacrimilor tale ai lucrat pustiul cel neroditor şi cu suspinurile cele dintru adânc ai făcut ostenelile tale însutit roditoare; şi te-ai făcut luminător lumii, strălucind cu minunile, Teofan, părintele nostru. Roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu ca să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Teofan Mărturisitorul din Singriana, glasul 8. The day page carries a second troparion for him as well, the common of venerables in glasul 1.

english.text: With the streams of your tears you tilled the barren desert, and with sighs from the depths you made your labours bear fruit a hundredfold; and you became a light to the world, shining with wonders, Theophanes our father. Pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Din înălţime primind Dum­nezeiasca descoperire, ai ieşit în grabă din mijlocul zgomo­telor şi ducând viaţă călugă­rească, cuvioase, ai primit lu­crarea minunilor şi harul pro­feţiei, lipsindu-te de soţie şi de bogăţie.

source.text: Doxologia — Condacul Sfântului Cuvios Teofan Mărturisitorul din Singriana, glasul 2, podobie «Cele de sus căutând...»

english.text: Receiving divine revelation from on high, you went out in haste from the midst of the tumult; and living the monastic life, venerable one, you received the working of wonders and the grace of prophecy, having given up wife and wealth.

hymns.text: Ὀρθοδοξίας ὁδηγέ, εὐσεβείας Διδάσκαλε καί σεμνότητος, τῆς Οἰκουμένης ὁ φωστήρ, τῶν Μοναζόντων θεόπνευστον ἐγκαλλώπισμα, Θεοφάνη σοφέ, ταῖς διδαχαῖς σου πάντας ἐφώτισας, λύρα τοῦ Πνεύματος. Πρέσβευε Χριστῷ τῷ Θεῷ, σωθῆναι τάς ψυχάς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος πλ. δ’, on the page of Όσιος Θεοφάνης ο Ομολογητής της Συγριανής. It names him. The page prints a kontakion in Ἦχος β’ (Τά ἄνω ζητῶν), a second in Ἦχος πλ. β’, an oikos and a kathisma in Ἦχος γ’ beside it.

english.text: Guide of Orthodoxy, teacher of piety and of gravity, luminary of the inhabited world, God-inspired adornment of monastics, wise Theophanes: by your teachings you enlightened all, lyre of the Spirit. Intercede with Christ our God that our souls be saved.
